baseline.notes: JS is main.js from dashboard/src/main.ts (bun build --minify). The JS ceiling equals the T1 baseline, so there is zero headroom until T4 lowers the target to 120 KB. This is intended. CSS is dashboard/public/styles.css, tokens.css and fonts/fonts.css, the stylesheets the dashboard ships. The CSS ceiling is the spec's 25 KB.

t2.notes: T2 (#8699) raises the interim JS ceiling by 5,451 B over the T1 baseline (42,553 B) for the shell: destination router with legacy redirects, APG tablist, Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette, keyboard shortcuts and sheet, native-dialog confirmations, connection states, and the UI primitives in components/ui. The byte breakdown is in the T2 PR body. There is no headroom by design. T4 (#8701) deletes the canvas, sprites and retired views; re-measure and lower this ceiling then.
